name: playmat
description: A shared virtual table for paper-style Magic: The Gathering

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w local-server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared --if-present && npm run test -w web --if-present && npm run test -w local-server --if-present
